newsitem.title: USA: PPG Industries to issue $200 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: PPG Industries to issue $200 mln in notes.

text.p: PPG Industries said on Tuesday it would issue $100 million of 6.25 percent notes, priced at 99.522 to yield 6.363 percent, due February 15, 2002, and $100 million of 6.875 percent notes, priced at 99.933 to yield 6.882 percent, due February 15, 2012.
CS First Boston, Goldman, Sachs & Co, and J.P. Morgan Securities Inc are co-managers of the offering, it said.
Net proceeds would be used for general corporate purposes, including repayment of commercial paper, PPG said.
The company produces coatings, glass, fiberglass and chemicals.
